title: Basic Commands [cat]
description:
# cat
Cat outputs the contents of a file. It stands for concatenate. To cat a file, you simply type `cat PATH`.
## Assignment:
A new fraud report came in! Cat the fraud/reports.txt file and put its contents into the text box.
expectedOutput:
Report: This bank is a scam.
Details: WHY IS MY APY -0.21 AND MY INTREST FOR A 10K LOAN 17K IN ONE YEAR
Name: Steve
